spoken: [curious] Ever wondered why your ears pop on a plane?
caption: Ever wondered why your ears pop on a plane?

spoken: Here's what's actually happening... inside your head.
caption: Here's what's actually happening inside your head.

spoken: Behind your eardrum sits a tiny pocket of air - your middle ear.
caption: Behind your eardrum sits a tiny pocket of air - your middle ear.

spoken: On the ground, the pressure inside matches the air outside. Perfectly balanced.
caption: On the ground, the pressure inside matches the air outside. Perfectly balanced.

spoken: But as the plane climbs... the cabin pressure drops.
caption: But as the plane climbs, the cabin pressure drops.

spoken: [slightly tense] The trapped air pushes outward... and your eardrum bulges, like a balloon.
caption: The trapped air pushes outward, and your eardrum bulges, like a balloon.

spoken: Then a tiny tube to your throat - the Eustachian tube - cracks open.
caption: Then a tiny tube to your throat - the Eustachian tube - cracks open.

spoken: Air escapes, the pressure evens out, and... [playful] pop!
caption: Air escapes, the pressure evens out, and... POP!

spoken: The tube doesn't open on its own as easily... so your eardrum gets pushed inward.
caption: The tube doesn't open on its own as easily, so your eardrum gets pushed inward.

spoken: [warm] That's why swallowing, yawning, or chewing gum helps - they pull the tube open.
caption: That's why swallowing, yawning, or chewing gum helps - they pull the tube open.

spoken: [cheerful] Follow for more weird things your body does.
caption: Follow for more weird things your body does.
